recentItems.title: 💥OH NO! THE BUG TEAM IS TRAPPED! | Back to School 🚌🔔
recentItems.description:
🪲 The bug team is in big trouble, and only you can save them!

🔔 Subscribe to the Lloyd channel: https://aard.mn/LOTF_Sub
👀 Watch more videos: https://aard.mn/LOTFclips

Lloyd is a young fly with plenty to prove - it's not easy being the middle child of 451, living in an apple with your long-suffering parents, cheeky little sister and 224 maggots. With his best friend Abacus the woodlouse, his little sister PB, and eccentric tagalong Cornea Butterfly at his side, Lloyd faces endless awkward, annoying and occasionally life-threatening situations largely of his own devising - because when you're only one centimetre high, even tiny problems can lead to massive consequences. Get ready to find out what insects really get up to when we're not paying attention. Starring Tom Rosenthal (Lloyd), Alex Lawther (Abacus), Lauren Patel (PB), Teresa Gallagher (Cornea Butterfly) and Callum Scott Howells (Berry).
